_comment: Waived SelectionState-shaped property accesses. Each entry needs file, the exact waived construct, and a reason. A missing file or a vanished construct fails. Two kinds of entry live here and the reason must say which. A PENDING waiver is removed in the same PR that deletes the access. A PERMANENT one marks a construct that is not a SelectionState access at all, matched only because the receiver is named selection or sel; do not convert a permanent entry to a helper call.

entries.reason: permanent: not a SelectionState. AISessionTurn.selection is AISessionSelectionSnapshot (extensions/ai types/session.ts:133), a plain anchor/focus/blockRange/isMultiBlock record with no type discriminant, deep-cloned here. getSelectionBlockRange switches on sel.type and does not accept it; forcing the call through a cast falls to the never default and yields undefined.
